selection.consistency_scope: Recomputed best epoch and LR selection from logged dev histories, then method and primary seed; independently recomputed selected dev prediction metrics. This establishes internal consistency, not independent proof of execution chronology.

conclusion.dev_selection_improves: dropout_2view has the highest reused-dev mean macro-F1; its primary seed43 follows the declared macro-F1-first rule despite seed44 having higher dev accuracy.
conclusion.test_regression_evidence: No support for improvement on test73: dropout_2view has lower macro-F1 than baseline at every matched seed; its primary seed43 has fewer correct predictions and lower macro-F1 than baseline seed44. R-drop also has lower macro-F1 than baseline at every matched seed, with mixed accuracy changes.
conclusion.kl_specific_evidence: R-drop is not selected by reused-dev scores. Its test mean macro-F1 is slightly above dropout_2view but below baseline; the narrow fixed sample does not establish a general KL benefit.
conclusion.acceptance: Test73 and all legacy splits were previously inspected and are regression-only. This ZIP contains no new independent holdout or real-user/ASR evaluation; independent acceptance remains false.
conclusion.uncertainty: Three seeds on the same 73 examples, sparse per-label support (2-6 test rows), reused dev selection, synthetic text, and no inference replay limit conclusions. No production adoption is justified by this audit.
